name: Procgen Benchmark
summary: 程序生成的视觉强化学习环境集合，提供可控动作、观测和关卡状态轨迹。
summaryEn: Procedurally generated visual RL environments with controllable actions, observations, and level-state trajectories.
verdict: 程序生成视觉动力学基准
wmNote: 训练/测试关卡分离可评估世界模型泛化。

evidence.sourceTitle: [1912.01588] Leveraging Procedural Generation to Benchmark Reinforcement Learning
evidence.statement: Sixteen procedurally generated game environments supply controlled interaction episodes; distinguish the base environments from derived rollout generators.
